definition: Independent alternative communications paths, nodes or providers that maintain connectivity when a primary element fails. Includes route diversity, backup links, redundant nodes and provider diversity with an explicit continuity function. Additional capacity or coverage alone is insufficient. Data or application recovery is disaster_recovery; backup electricity is backup_power; protective engineering is resilient_infrastructure_design. Links to recovery sites qualify only when an independent alternative communications path is explicit. Excludes redundancy of roads and other nondigital transport infrastructure.
